title: Make app-tab configuration registry-aware and live-reloadable
description:
## Finding

The public `[apps]` configuration cannot actually order or select the shipped Observe tab. Core validation recognizes only `work`; the host later appends enabled registry entries, so `default_tab = "observe"` normalizes back to Work and `tab_order` cannot place Observe. Unknown names are silently discarded. The host also builds `AppHost` only once, so live configuration changes do not enable, disable, reorder, or reselect tiles.

## Evidence at audited commit

* `crates/thegn-core/src/config.rs:3326-3374` defines `BUILTIN_TABS = ["work"]`; both `effective_tab_order` and `normalized_default_tab` filter through that list.
* `crates/thegn-host/src/apps/registry.rs:30-35` registers the shipped `observe` app separately.
* `apps/mod.rs:129-171` receives the already-filtered order, then appends every enabled app; it cannot recover requested placement or default selection.
* `run.rs:6270` constructs `AppHost` once. The config-reload block updates many supervisors but not app tabs.
* Config tests explicitly expect non-Work ids to be filtered rather than proving the shipped app is configurable.

## Impact

Documented fields accept values that have no effect. Users cannot start in Observe or choose its ordering, and a reload can show new config while the running UI remains on the old registry. Adding another in-tree app compounds the mismatch and creates index/lifecycle hazards.

## Implementation constraints

* Establish one authoritative runtime app catalog shared by validation, schema/help generation, config resolution, and host construction without introducing a core→host dependency cycle.
* Distinguish disabled-known ids from unknown ids and surface actionable diagnostics.
* Preserve stable ids across reload; reconcile by id, never old vector index.
* Define policy for default removal and the active tile being disabled.
* Coordinate reload with focus, shutdown, callback generation, theme, and cached-buffer invalidation.

## Acceptance criteria

* `default_tab = "observe"` starts in Observe when enabled.
* Any valid order of Work plus all enabled registered apps is preserved.
* Unknown, duplicate, disabled-default, and platform-unavailable ids have tested explicit outcomes.
* Live reload can enable, disable, reorder, and change the default without stale callbacks or leaked tiles.
* Example config, JSON schema, environment/CLI overlays, and runtime behavior agree.
